notes.title: UPDATE 15 (PHOTO MODE)
notes.content:
Photo mode has now been added, now just press the T key to switch to photo mode. I guess this changes everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923955/de37ad38bc4e31881afea063c1a73f93ad7d52fd.png[/img]

notes.title: Home system, UI rework, optimization (UPDATE 14)
notes.content:
1. The home system has been added. Now you can exchange carrots for furniture. There are currently 3 furniture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923955/428250a3e5c85202ed201f667e0a895d5284a61c.jpg[/img]

2. The map UI has been reworked and is no longer displayed in full screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923955/7f8500cfebe271fd86a72bf7069c6fbd874c666e.jpg[/img]

3. The ranking is updated, and the new ranking is "Days".

4. Optimized the behavior of AI wolf.

notes.title: UPDATE 13
notes.content: Bunny hats are now added, and there are 7 different Bunny hats that can be unlocked.

notes.title: New Control System! (important)
notes.content:
I know that many people do not like the old control system and find it difficult to control. Now the new control system has been updated and it is absolutely easy to use.

1. Abandon the old control system and update the new control system.

2. Now the weather time will also be archived.

3. Added the sound effect of Bunny fight.

4. UI beautification.

notes.title: UPDATE 11
notes.content:
1. The name is now displayed on the head of the full heart AI bunny.

2. Now the full heart AI Bunny can only mate with the player Bunny, but not with other AI Bunny.

3. Optimized the UI interface.

notes.title: UPDATE 10 (IMPORTANT)
notes.content:
1. Players can now recruit and name 5 AI Bunnies who help carry carrots. These 5 Bunnies will be saved by the game and appear next to the player after starting the game next time. Of course, you can release them at any time.

At this point, the gameplay has changed dramatically. Players are no longer alone, but can start to build their own Bunny team.

2. Added an expression system to AI Bunny. Now AI Bunny can make three expressions: happy, angry, and surprised.

3. Added instruction menu.

4. In addition, I optimized the carrot collision body, and now the player Bunny will no longer be stuck by carrots when digging carrots.

Please enjoy this update.

notes.title: Update 9
notes.content:
1. Now the player's baby rabbit will always follow the player after birth.

2. Added new game sound effects.

3. Vegetables will no longer collide with players.

4. Slightly reduced the chance of AI Bunny like each other, slightly increased the cooling time after mating, and increased the time of pregnancy.

notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
1. The game UI now supports controllers.

2. Added exit prompts in the rabbit's home.

notes.title: Great performance improvements (update 7)
notes.content:
1. The latest patch has been released. Depending on the computer hardware configuration, the game can get 50% -100% performance improvement.

FPS almost doubled on my 2060S.

If your previous game experience was smooth, then now it is as smooth as silk, or it can be said to be extremely smooth.

2. Now if the player rabbit falls into the sea, the rabbit will be automatically sent back to the ground.

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
The friendliness system has been updated.

1. Now players Bunny and AI Bunny can also try to have children.

2. Optimize the logic of AI Bunny.

3. Update the UI icon.

4. Fix a UI display bug.

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
The terrain has been redone to make the game area more concentrated.

1. Added option to turn off wolf AI.

2. Added wolf sound: Howling.

3. Added two new carrot drop points.

4. The degree of hunger is now slower, and rabbits can live longer.

5. Increased the probability of foggy weather and rainy weather.

6. Now the carrot does not appear underwater.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
A simple ecosystem has taken shape.

1. Added mating system. Now AI rabbits can have children.

2. Added AI baby bunny.

3. Updated controller support.

4. Added map orientation icon for player rabbit.

5. Performance optimization.

notes.title: Update 3 (Important)
notes.content:
After the release of this game, I felt the players ’love for Bunny. Although the game introduction said that the purpose of the game is to keep collecting carrots, I still received a lot of gameplay suggestions, which made me think this game should have more Gameplay.

So I spent three days re-optimizing the game and redoing the entire AI system. Now the game has added the enemy "wolf" and has more AI bunny rabbits. I am gradually randomizing the game, hoping to build a simple ecosystem.

What's new in this patch:

1. Added the enemy "wolf". The wolf will bite the rabbit, and the rabbit can escape by jumping into the hole.

2. The map interface has added the number of AI displays, and players can check the number of existing AI rabbits at any time.

3. Now AI Bunny will eat, be careful it grabs your food.

4. AI performance has been greatly optimized, and the number of AI has now doubled.

5. Optimized the collision body.

6. Fixed the bug of tutorial.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
1. Added rabbit home interior (press E to jump into rabbit hole).

2. Added rebuild rabbit function.

3. A small lake has been added near the home (press M to see the map).

4. Added X-axis / Y-axis speed adjustment option.

5. Added invert Y axis option.

6. Now the positions of carrots and vegetables are random in each game.

7. Terrain optimization.

8. carrot collision body optimization.

9. Performance optimization.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
1. Added the function of guiding home. Now when the rabbit bites the radish, an arrow to guide home will appear. This function can be turned off in the settings.

2. Added mouse wheel zoom function.

3. Optimize the camera transition effect greatly, and the problem of quick position change will no longer occur when the lens encounters trees and stones.

4. The camera is now smoother, and the small shake problem when bunny runs should have disappeared.

5. The speed of the AI Bunny has been reduced. Now the player Bunny can catch up with the AI Bunny at normal speed.

6.  AI bunny will not pass through particularly high slopes now, and further smooth the other slopes that may pass by to help AI bunny climbing.

7. Added the rotation prompt icon in the bunny creation interface.

8. The menu buttons have been optimized.

9. UI beautification.
